raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-UK-PadeswoodCCUS",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Rising carbon prices could make cement production uncompetitive without CCS, threatening revenue and market share.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Secure long‑term revenue support with price escalation clauses and monitor carbon market trends to adjust business case as needed.",
      "evidence": "Without CCUS, the cement industry will increasingly be exposed to a rising carbon price, impacting competitiveness with imports."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Implementation of the UK Carbon‑Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) may cause carbon leakage if the plant is not decarbonised by 2027.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Accelerate CCS deployment to meet CBAM timelines and maintain active engagement with policy makers to ensure compliance.",
      "evidence": "The UK Carbon‑Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)... without investment in CCUS, companies may de‑prioritise their UK interests and shift production elsewhere."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "A delay in Final Investment Decision could push Commercial Operation Date, increasing costs and reducing early revenue.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement rigorous schedule management, early procurement, and a contingency buffer of 4‑5 months to absorb potential slips.",
      "evidence": "Option 2: Padeswood Delayed... resulting in a subsequent 5‑month delay to COD."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Uncertainty around the Revenue Support Agreement (RSA) could undermine the project's financial viability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Negotiate firm RSA terms with a minimum price floor and embed performance‑linked payments in the contract.",
      "evidence": "5.4.1 Revenue Support Agreement (RSA)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Project could be discontinued if key milestones or funding commitments are not met.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Maintain regular governance reviews, secure staged funding commitments, and keep stakeholder engagement active throughout delivery.",
      "evidence": "5.4.2 Discontinuation risk for Padeswood"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Reliance on Exchequer funding via SoSDA agreements may be jeopardised by policy changes.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Align project deliverables with government priorities, diversify financing sources, and include contingency funding in the business case.",
      "evidence": "5.4.3 Exchequer funding Secretary of State direct agreements (SoSDA)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Potential fraud in procurement or grant administration could lead to financial loss and reputational damage.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement strict procurement controls, independent audits, and real‑time monitoring of grant expenditures.",
      "evidence": "5.4.4 Fraud"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Cross‑chain integration with the CO₂ transport and storage network may encounter technical mismatches causing delays.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop a detailed interface management plan, hold joint technical working groups, and conduct early integration testing.",
      "evidence": "5.4.6 Cross‑chain and cross‑cutting risks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "First‑of‑a‑kind CCS technology at a cement plant may under‑perform, failing to capture required CO₂ volumes.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Carry out pilot trials, secure independent technical assurance (WSP), and embed performance guarantees in the contract.",
      "evidence": "first at‑scale UK cement plant incorporating Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) technology; Independent assurance provided by ... WSP (technical)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Complex governance involving multiple bodies could lead to coordination failures and decision delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Define a clear RACI matrix, hold regular steering committee meetings, and establish formal escalation procedures.",
      "evidence": "4.5 Governance and Oversight; 6.4 Post‑Padeswood FID roles and responsibilities"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Changes to the CCS Network Code could alter contractual obligations and increase compliance costs.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Monitor regulatory developments, include change‑in‑law clauses, and maintain active dialogue with Ofgem.",
      "evidence": "4.6 Network Code Compliance"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Future reduction of subsidy support may render the project financially unsustainable in later market phases.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop a post‑subsidy business model, attract private investment early, and pursue cost‑reduction innovations.",
      "evidence": "4.7 Long‑Term Strategy ... future market phases are expected to operate with reduced subsidy support"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Capital cost overruns could exceed the 50 % grant contribution, stretching the project budget.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement detailed cost monitoring, use fixed‑price contracts where feasible, and retain a contingency reserve.",
      "evidence": "CIF Grant provides upfront capital support during the construction phase, up to 50 % of Padeswood’s eligible capital costs"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Volatile energy prices may increase operating expenditures and affect profitability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Secure long‑term energy supply agreements and employ price‑hedging mechanisms.",
      "evidence": "operating costs, energy costs and financing costs"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Project is still at pre‑FID maturity; unresolved technical or commercial issues could emerge before construction.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Complete remaining design work, conduct independent technical reviews, and update the risk register regularly.",
      "evidence": "4.1 Project Maturity and Development Status"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Failure to meet CO₂ capture volume targets could trigger penalties and reduce revenue under the ICC contract.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate strict performance thresholds, real‑time monitoring, and remedial action plans in the contract.",
      "evidence": "commercial agreements include ... performance thresholds, safeguards against under‑delivery"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Insufficient utilisation of the transport and storage network may lower the value‑for‑money of the HyNet cluster.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Identify additional CO₂ users, negotiate flexible capacity contracts, and promote network utilisation through market mechanisms.",
      "evidence": "volume of unutilised network capacity (Mtpa) across the clusters by 2030"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Force majeure events or changes in law could disrupt contract performance and financing.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Include robust force‑majeure and change‑in‑law clauses, obtain appropriate insurance, and develop contingency response plans.",
      "evidence": "contractual clauses covering change in law and force majeure"
    }
  ]
}
